startup_sequence: write REG0x01=0x56 (14.5mA nominal, below panel 15mA maximum)
default_register_hazard: REG0x01 resets to 20mA and REG0x02 resets to 36V; PWM must stay low until reprogrammed
hardware_enable_source: ESP32-S3 GPIO2 through R931; no longer XL9535 P15
charging_request: P05 CHG_REQUEST must remain0 unless the battery/charging configuration is separately qualified
